headline: Cook moves 19 House races toward Democrats, none toward Republicans
detail: Six seats went from Toss Up to Lean D (AZ-06, CO-08, NC-11, TX-34, VA-02, WI-03) and KY-06 and TX-35 became toss-ups. Cook now projects a Democratic gain of 12 to 22 seats.

headline: Raters shift South Carolina, Nebraska and Texas toward toss-up
detail: RealClearPolitics moved SC and NE to Toss Up and GA to Likely Dem on Oct 25; Inside Elections moved Texas to Toss-up on Oct 23. Cook still rates SC Lean R and NE Likely R.

headline: Final Maine and Alaska debates turn personal
detail: Collins and Jackson sparred after a protester interrupted; Sullivan and Peltola clashed over the Iran war and energy prices.

headline: More than 30 million ballots already cast
detail: Texas passed 4 million in its first week of early voting, which ends Oct 30. Turnout counts show who is voting, not how.
source: UF Election Lab via TNND, ABC13

headline: Texas stays within the margin of error
detail: A University of Houston poll (Oct 10–14) has Talarico 48, Paxton 46. Trump is scheduled in Nueces and Lubbock counties today.

headline: Generic ballot leads range from D +5 to D +11
detail: NYT/Siena and YouGov show Democrats up 11, Echelon Insights up 5. Polls overstated Democrats in some recent cycles.

headline: Obama to Atlanta Wednesday; Trump back to Iowa Sunday
detail: Obama was scheduled to campaign with El-Sayed in Detroit on Oct 24 and joins Ossoff on Oct 28. Trump returns to Iowa for Hinson on Nov 1.
